name: pptx

summary.en: Anthropic’s skill for building and editing PowerPoint decks, from reading existing slides to generating new ones from templates or HTML layouts.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品，用于创建和编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿，可读取已有幻灯片，也可基于模板或 HTML 版式生成新稿。

upstreamDescription: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
